'''''Omicron 1''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that was carrying [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] that were assigned to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] sabotaged the transport, leaving it stranded in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Alliance then sent a team consisting of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Red Squadron]], one of the pilots was [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] with a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]] [[Hunter (Lambda-class)|''Hunter'']] to board and capture the transport and then bring it to the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Inad (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Inad'']].

As soon as the shuttle boarded the transport [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] arrived to intercept. The Rebel fighters intercepted and destroyed them with losses occurred. When the transport was captured and the ''Inad'' arrived to pick up the transport, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' arrived and launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|Bombers]] and three transports arrived to intercept the captured transport. However Farlander in his Y-wing held of the attacking forces and the transport boarded the frigate, which jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
